definitions.gloss: cutting in half; halving; cut in two
definitions.explanation: The act of cutting something in half, or something that has been cut in half. Commonly used in cooking and food contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦トマト→トマト：05192_tomato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{半切|はんぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{半切|はんぎ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}えた→添える：13315_soeru⟧。
examples.english: I added a lemon cut in half.

examples.japanese: ⟦アボカド→アボカド：10704_abokado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{半切|はんぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Eat half an avocado with salt.

notes:
{半切|はんぎ}り means cutting something in half, or the resulting halved piece. It appears almost exclusively in cooking and recipe contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {半切|はんぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cut in half
- ⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧{半切|はんぎ}り: cut in half lengthwise
- ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧{半切|はんぎ}り: cut in half crosswise
- {半切|はんぎ}り⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧: a lemon half

RELATED CUTTING TERMS:
- ⟦{薄切|うすぎ}り→薄切り：07475_usugiri⟧: thin slices
- ⟦{輪切|わぎ}り→輪切り：07474_wagiri⟧: round slices
- ⟦{千切|せんぎ}り→千切り：07473_sengiri⟧: julienne/shredded
- ⟦{乱切|らんぎ}り→乱切り：08067_rangiri⟧: irregular chunks
- {四|よ}つ{切|ぎ}り: quartered

USAGE:
Not to be confused with the homophone {半切|はんぎり}, a flat-bottomed wooden tub used for mixing ⟦{酢飯|すめし}→酢飯：14460_sumeshi⟧ (sushi rice). That word is also written {半桶|はんぎり}.
